loginNudge.label: Checkout: "Ordered before? Log in"
loginNudge.help: Under the checkout's first heading, for a visitor who is not signed in: a line with a link to log in for his saved address and offers.

doorNote.label: Checkout: door note
doorNote.help: A short line under the settled delivery area, in your own words (Door note words). Nothing shows until you write them.

text.label: Door note words
text.help: Your own words for the door note, in English and Bengali (up to 160 letters each). Empty: nothing shows. Write only what your Cash on Delivery and return rules really do.

helpStripDesktop.label: Checkout: help strip on a computer
helpStripDesktop.help: The "Need help with your order?" strip on a computer too. Off: phones and tablets only.

waSendBag.label: Bag: "Send my bag on WhatsApp"
waSendBag.help: A button under Checkout that shows the bag as a message and opens WhatsApp with it, to the store's own number. Nothing is sent by itself.

setLine.label: Bag: the set line in "You may also like"
setLine.help: The one-line "Buy 2 and save" offer inside the bag's upsell, when a take-more-pay-less offer applies.

upsell.label: Thank-you page: "You may also like"
upsell.help: Products from the order's categories (never what is in it) on the thank-you page, with how many cards.
